strategy.name: Drugs@FDA Record Check
strategy.rule: On an FDA drug-decision market whose title names a drug, buy YES at or below 97c (displayed spread <= 5c) when openFDA Drugs@FDA lists an approved application for that drug; abstain when the lookup finds nothing.

source.label: openFDA Drugs@FDA (public, no key) -> Kalshi KXFDA* drug-decision series

strategy.why: A Drugs@FDA application with an approved ORIG submission is primary evidence that the approval already happened. Drugs@FDA publishes no PDUFA target action date (IRR-27), so absence of a record is never traded as evidence of a future decision.
